goal: Implement the Prism evaluation and quality gating platform and Lumen session intelligence engine across 6 modular Rust workspace crates.
architecture: Implements a layered safe Rust monorepo starting from Layer 1 permissive primitives (lumen-model) through zero-copy streaming ingestion (lumen-session), 22 single-pass accumulators and petgraph Trajectory DAG analysis (lumen-analysis, lumen-pattern), and decoupled 4-engine evaluation suites with VCR replay (prism-core, prism-grader), exposed via standalone pre-compiled CLI binaries.

batches.title: Layer 2: 22 Accumulators & Trajectory DAG Graph Engine
Layer 3: Evaluation Core, VCR Cassettes & The 4 Graders
Layer 4: Standalone CLIs, Config & GitHub Actions CI

tasks.title: Implement Canonical IR, Turn, ToolIntent, and Timing Models
steps: 1. Define Root workspace Cargo.toml with resolver = '2' and workspace members.
2. Implement CanonicalTranscript, CanonicalTurn, ToolIntent, and TurnRole with compact_str and smallvec in crates/lumen-model/src/transcript.rs.
3. Write unit tests in crates/lumen-model/tests/test_transcript.rs verifying serialization roundtrips.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-model` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-model): define canonical transcript, turn, and tool intent primitives

tasks.title: Implement Exact Mathematical Token Economics and Model Pricing Matrix
steps: 1. Implement ModelPricing struct with 4-tier rates (input_base, cache_write 1.25x, cache_read 0.10x, output) for Sonnet, Haiku, Opus, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek.
2. Implement TokenEconomics calculation for cache_hit_ratio, baseline_cost_no_cache_usd, and financial efficiency_multiplier.
3. Write tests in crates/lumen-model/tests/test_pricing.rs verifying billing math against official Anthropic rates.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-model` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-model): implement prompt cache pricing matrix and economics calculations

tasks.title: Implement SessionAdapter Trait and Auto-Fingerprint Ingestion Engine
steps: 1. Define SessionAdapter and AdapterCapabilities traits in crates/lumen-session/src/adapter.rs.
2. Implement fast sub-millisecond fingerprint detector inspecting first 2KB of log bytes.
3. Write unit tests in crates/lumen-session/tests/test_fingerprint.rs verifying detection of Claude Code, AGY, and Codex logs.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-session` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-session): implement SessionAdapter trait and orchestrator fingerprinting

tasks.title: Implement SIMD-Accelerated ClaudeCodeAdapter and PreCompact Snapshot Merging
steps: 1. Implement ClaudeCodeAdapter using simd-json and memory-mapped reader.
2. Implement PreCompact snapshot merge taking max() over cumulative tokens.
3. Write test verifying handling of corrupt lines and non-destructive snapshot merging.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-session` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-session): implement simd-json Claude adapter and pre-compact snapshot merge

tasks.title: Implement the 22 Single-Pass Streaming Accumulators
steps: 1. Implement RawMessageAccumulator and EntryAccumulator traits.
2. Implement the 22 accumulators (token_usage, circuit_breaker, mcp_affinity, flow, turn_duration, etc.).
3. Write tests verifying single-pass O(N) extraction with 0 heap allocations in inner loop.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-analysis` and confirm GREEN.

tasks.title: Implement TrajectoryGraph and Tarjan SCC Cycle Detection Engine
steps: 1. Implement TrajectoryGraph using petgraph::graph::DiGraph with ToolNode elements.
2. Implement Tarjan SCC cycle detector identifying exploration loops of depth >= 3 without state mutations.
3. Implement Trajectory Efficiency Index calculation E = (Mutations + Targeted Reads) / Invocations.
4. Write tests verifying circular loop detection on real agent search traces.
5. Run `cargo test -p lumen-pattern` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-pattern): implement petgraph Trajectory DAG and Tarjan SCC cycle detector

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Session Parallel Directory Scanner using Rayon and Memmap2
steps: 1. Implement parallel_scan_sessions using rayon par_iter and memmap2.
2. Parse multi-session directory trees into aggregated summaries in parallel.
3. Write integration test scanning 50 mock session logs in under 100ms.
4. Run `cargo test -p lumen-analysis` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-analysis): implement rayon parallel multi-session scanner

tasks.title: Implement TaskSpec, Scorecard, VCR Cassettes, and Hermetic Sandbox
steps: 1. Define TaskSpec, Scorecard, and VcrCassette domain types.
2. Implement WorkspaceSandbox creating hermetic /tmp/ git worktrees.
3. Implement VcrCassetteStore with deterministic SHA-256 prompt hashing and replay.
4. Write tests verifying sandbox isolation and sub-5ms cassette replay.
5. Run `cargo test -p prism-core` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(prism-core): implement TaskSpec, VCR cassette store, and hermetic sandbox

tasks.title: Implement Dual-Mode Execution Drivers (Local CLI, Direct API, and VCR Replay)
steps: 1. Implement ExecutionDriver trait.
2. Implement ClaudeCliDriver and AgyCliDriver spawning local CLI in non-interactive mode.
3. Implement AnthropicApiDriver using reqwest with prompt caching headers.
4. Implement VcrReplayDriver reading frozen cassettes.
5. Write unit tests in crates/prism-core/tests/test_drivers.rs.
6. Run `cargo test -p prism-core` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(prism-core): implement dual-mode execution drivers for CLI, API, and VCR

tasks.title: Implement the 4 Evaluation Grader Engines and eval-report@1 Generator
steps: 1. Implement RedGreenGrader verifying SWE-bench style state transitions.
2. Implement TrajectoryGrader asserting cache hit >= 90% and zero circular loops.
3. Implement CircuitBreakerGrader asserting <= 2 review rounds.
4. Implement CalibratedJudge evaluating formative G-Eval rubrics with Opus.
5. Implement report generation conforming strictly to eval-report@1 schema.
6. Run `cargo test -p prism-grader` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(prism-grader): implement the 4 evaluation graders and eval-report@1 generator

tasks.title: Implement prism-cli (test, bench, rebuild, record) and TOML Configuration
steps: 1. Define clap CLI commands and miette diagnostic error formatting.
2. Implement PrismConfig loading from prism.toml with environment and flag overrides.
3. Implement prism test, prism bench --skill, prism rebuild, and prism record subcommands.
4. Write CLI integration tests in crates/prism-cli/tests/test_cli_commands.rs.
5. Run `cargo test -p prism-cli` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(prism-cli): implement standalone evaluation binary and TOML config parser

tasks.title: Implement lumen-cli (trace, audit, scan, insights) and Terminal Visualizer
steps: 1. Implement lumen trace rendering ASCII trajectory DAG timeline.
2. Implement lumen audit displaying token spend and prompt cache hit percentage.
3. Implement lumen scan running parallel multi-session summaries.
4. Write tests in crates/lumen-cli/tests/test_lumen_cli.rs.
5. Run `cargo test -p lumen-cli` and confirm GREEN.
tasks.commit_message: feat(lumen-cli): implement standalone telemetry and audit visualization binary
